title: Rokega rab zarur
body:
Rokega rab zarur
Dekh kar  6
rokega rab zarur gunahgar dekh kar    4
par jaane dega sheh ka azaadar dekh kar
<<MINI>>
rokega.................2
<<DIVIDER>>
ishqe ali me logo nuseri bhi mat bano         2
nafrat ali ko hoti hai ye pyar dekh kar
<<MINI>>

<<DIVIDER>>
hum kalmago se achhe hai har kaum kehti hai    2
binte nabi ki kabr ko mismaar dekh kar
<<MINI>>
rokega.................2
<<DIVIDER>>
kehti hai maa khuda kare bandh  jaye aur maraz    2
mujhko ghame hussain me bimaar dekh kar

rokega..................2

par yaad ali ki aati hai deewar dekh kar
<<MINI>>
rokega..................2
<<DIVIDER>>
keemat bataoo kyu tujhe rizwan ashq ki      2
boli lagaunga me kharidar dekh kar
<<MINI>>

ye faisla to hona hai kirdar dekh kar

rokega..................2

haa thik hai likha karo sajjad marhaba      2
bas itna kehde maula ye ashaaar dekh kar
